about: Authored held-out cases beyond R01-R12 (spec section 13). Only `text`, `candidates`, `relevant`, `seq`, `sentAt` become model input; `category` and `expect` are used to score after the fact. Reviewed exercise expectations, not clinical ground truth. Synthetic. Do not tune prompts on this set.

w-school.text: Possible person trapped in the collapsed east wing of Maple Elementary.

w-shelter.text: Community center shelter needs cots and blankets tonight.

w-bridge.text: Mill Road bridge is closed to vehicles.

w-court.text: Elderly residents may be stuck on the upper floor of Cedar Court.

w-depot.text: Fuel depot on Route 9 has no diesel left for generators.

cases.text: The east section of Maple Elementary came down and someone may still be underneath.
People at the community center are short on beds and covers for the night.
Vehicles cannot cross the Mill Road bridge right now.
The Route 9 fuel depot has run dry, generators will stop soon.
My cousin told me someone at the lumber yard said a worker might be pinned under a pallet rack.
Heard from a driver that the Cedar Court residents were taken out already, not sure who said it.
Someone passing by said Route 12 might be flooded near the creek.
A man at the gas station says a family is waiting on a roof out past the quarry.
Nobody is hurt at the Mill Road bridge, it is only closed to cars.
We do not need more blankets at the community center, we need cots.
There is no one trapped in the Route 9 depot office; the problem is only the empty diesel tank.
Route 12 is not open to trucks anymore.
Has anyone reached the people on the upper floor of Cedar Court?
Is a rescue team on the way to Maple Elementary east wing?
Can anybody tell me if the Mill Road bridge has been cleared yet?
Who is going to pick up the people stranded at the orchard barn?
Cedar Court first floor is clear. Nobody has been up to the second floor yet.
We checked the west classrooms at Maple Elementary and they are empty. The east wing is still unchecked.
Cots delivered to the community center for the east hall only; the west hall is still bare.
Everyone we found at the school gym is out. We have not been near the east wing.
From last night: Cedar Court is fully evacuated.

relevant.text: Someone is calling from an upper window at Cedar Court.

cases.text: Earlier this morning the depot had a diesel delivery.

relevant.text: Depot is empty again, generators are down.

cases.text: Report from yesterday afternoon: Route 12 was closed by a fallen tree.
Sent hours ago: the east wing at Maple Elementary is empty.

relevant.text: Tapping sounds from under the rubble at Maple Elementary.

cases.text: Correction: the Mill Road bridge is open, it is the Elm Street bridge that is closed.
Correction: it was Cedar Court annex, not Cedar Court, that has people on the upper floor.
